title: Yellow Crispy Venezuelan Chicken Empanadas
description: Buttery and crispy Venezuelan empanadas filled with chicken, perfect for a weeknight dinner, made with soya milk and render fat for a diabetic friendly option.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the flour, soya milk, and render fat to make the empanada dough.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of the chicken mixture in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough in half to form a half moon shape and press the edges to seal.
Brush the tops with a little bit of render fat.
Bake the empanadas for 20 minutes or until they are golden brown.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
